summary: FB Bancorp filed an 8-K announcing completion of its second stock repurchase program. The company repurchased 1,785,375 shares, or 10% of its then-outstanding common stock, at an average price of $13.717 per share inclusive of costs. The program is closed; management noted it will further explore capital management tools, including a possible third buyback. No tender offer or shareholder vote was required; the buyback was executed in the open market. Watch for potential future repurchase announcements and the impact on share count and EPS accretion. No risk-arb angle applies here.
